summary.content:
Today's selection covers 90 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 56 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI warns GPT-6.2 Astra will hit usage limits 40% faster because it fixed a bug
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Remus malware steals Gmail messages via fake Google Sheets extension
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 19 articles published in the last 24 hours
